race.comment: Looks a wide-open contest with some value to be found. TASSORATI (12) broke the maiden status at Gatton two back before just missing the frame at Eagle Farm last time out. Gets in well at the weights with the 3kg claim and should be able to slot in from the low draw. Sure to be right there at the business end. CANTARITO (6) went down by a narrow margin at the Sunny Coast when resuming and will have come on with that run now in the locker. Has to be included in calculations. DEEP FOCUS (1) resumes here but has revved up for this with two recent trials and does boast a first-up win in the past. Can run a big race while fresh. SPOT THE AUSSIE (5) has placed two from two around this circuit and will be cherry-ripe now third run back. No surprise to see him hit the frame.
